sloka: दुर्वृत्तमपि कः पुत्रम् त्यजेद्भुवि विचक्षणः ।कश्च प्रव्राज्यमानो वा नासूयेत्पितरम् सुतः ॥२-६४-६४॥
transliteration: durvṛttamapi kaḥ putram tyajedbhuvi vicakṣaṇaḥ ।kaśca pravrājyamāno vā nāsūyetpitaram sutaḥ ॥2-64-64॥

translations.english: Which clearsighted man in this world, will abandon his son even if he is of evil conduct? Which son will not get angry with his father when he is banished?
